talkTitle: Breaking a Jakarta EE App on Purpose: Chaos Testing Live
abstract:
We start a small Jakarta EE shop with three services on Kubernetes, then break it in front of you: we kill pods during checkout, inject 2 seconds of latency into the database, fill a disk, and cut the network between two zones.

After each failure we look at the dashboards together, see what the users would have seen, and fix the app live: timeouts, retries with backoff, MicroProfile Fault Tolerance bulkheads and fallbacks, and readiness probes that actually mean something.

Everything happens in a live cluster on stage. Attendees can follow along on their own laptop with a kind cluster from the workshop repository.
